by
  classical
  intro ϑ
  induction ϑ with
  | zero =>
      intro hϑ
      omega
  | succ ϑ ih =>
      intro _
      by_cases hϑ_zero : ϑ = 0
      · subst ϑ
        intro u hu
        have hprob :
            Pr_{let r ← $ᵖ F}[
              Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation (F := F) (u 0) (u 1) r, MC) ≤ e]
              > (ε : ℝ≥0) / (Fintype.card F : ℝ≥0) := by
          simpa [multilinearCombine] using hu
        have hbase := hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1) hprob
        have hu_pair : finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) = u := by
          funext i
          fin_cases i <;> rfl
        simpa [jointProximityNat₂, hu_pair] using hbase
      · have hϑ_pos : ϑ > 0 := by omega
        have ihϑ : δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat
            (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC)
            (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := ih hϑ_pos
        intro u hu
        let U₀ := (splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords (ϑ := ϑ) u).1
        let U₁ := (splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords (ϑ := ϑ) u).2
        let R := R_star_tensor MC (m := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) U₀ U₁
        have hsplit :
            Pr_{let r_last ← $ᵖ F;
               let r_init ← $ᵖ (Fin ϑ → F)}[
                multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close
                  (MC := MC) (u := u) (e := e) r_last r_init]
              > (((Nat.cast (R := ℝ≥0) (ϑ + 1)) * ε : ℝ≥0) /
                  (Fintype.card F : ℝ≥0)) := by
          simpa [multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close,
            Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using hu
        have hR :
            Pr_{let r ← $ᵖ F}[r ∈ R]
              > (ε : ENNReal) / (Fintype.card F : ENNReal) := by
          simpa [U₀, U₁, R] using
            (prob_R_star_gt_threshold (MC := MC) (ε := ε)
              (ϑ := ϑ) u e hsplit)
        have hline :
            Pr_{let r ← $ᵖ F}[
              Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation (F := F) (⋈| U₀) (⋈| U₁) r,
                MC ^⋈ (Fin (2 ^ ϑ))) ≤ e]
              > (ε : ℝ≥0) / (Fintype.card F : ℝ≥0) := by
          refine lt_of_lt_of_le hR ?_
          apply Pr_le_Pr_of_implies
          intro r hr
          have hr_close := correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor
            (MC := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε) (ϑ_pred := ϑ) ihϑ u
            (⟨r, by simpa [R, U₀, U₁] using hr⟩)
          simpa [jointProximityNat, U₀, U₁] using hr_close
        have hpair :=
          (h_interleaved_gaps (2 ^ ϑ) (by positivity))
            (⋈| U₀) (⋈| U₁) hline
        simpa [U₀, U₁, jointProximityNat₂, Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using hpair
diagnosis: The proof is missing the intended induction on the tensor dimension. The base case reduces one-variable multilinear combination to the affine-line hypothesis; the successor case splits the word stack, applies the induction hypothesis on parameters in `R_star_tensor`, uses `prob_R_star_gt_threshold`, and then invokes the affine-gap property of the corresponding interleaved code.
